title: 1D Gaussian Stationary Hold & Target Shift Recovery (Legacy Prior Cohort)
intuition: Historical pre-refactor comparison cohort of `gaussian1d_stability` retained under its original prior ownership contract so legacy baselines stay strictly separated from `recipe_owned_v1` tasks. Continues the candidate's own passing `gaussian1d_smoke` checkpoint to test the Law 4.4 settling-versus-tracking dilemma: first hold N(2, 0.5^2) stably across stationary updates, then rapidly re-acquire a shifted target within deadline and hold it.
failure_mode: Recipes with aggressive LR annealing freeze and miss the shifted target, whereas recipes without settling damping oscillate around the stationary bell curve and fail hold checks.
protocol_notes: Retained legacy diagnostic cohort for `gaussian1d_stability` before the recipe-owned prior refactor; cannot substitute for current ordinary qualification cells.
